Please use one of the issue templates instead of a blank issue:

- **Data error**: an area filed under the wrong parent, missing, or with a wrong code, name or shape.
- **Request**: a newer PSGC quarter, another format, or another way of splitting the files.

See the [contributing guide](https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-json-maps/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for what makes a report easy to act on.
